graph-0.purpose: Empty day in the practice graph; the ramp is the graph's own green, never next to a diff.

light-graph-0.purpose: Empty day in the practice graph; the ramp is the graph's own green, never next to a diff.

display.purpose: The single page title (h1), including the challenge title.

title.purpose: Sub-headings inside a sheet (h3) and field labels.

body.purpose: Running text; ledes and briefs capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Margin notes, coach progress, hints, metadata.

caption.purpose: Type badges, rail footer, Later tags.

galley.purpose: The learner's text in a galley and the answer textarea; open 1.85 leading for marks.

expression.purpose: Phrase on an expression card (20px on the review card).

mono-small.purpose: Chips, kbd keys, nav counts, model id.

chat.purpose: Message bubbles, peer-correction and coach-check diffs, the chat composer and correction textareas.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only (command palette, report dialog, menus). Dark theme.

shadows.name: float-light
shadows.purpose: Float shadow in the light theme.

shadows.name: inset-ring
shadows.purpose: Selection outline on the checked segment, the selected palette row, the selected moderation report, the current conversation row and the reported message in a moderation copy; not elevation.

shadows.name: separation-ring
shadows.purpose: Selection outline (not elevation) on the checked mascot in the picker.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for press and panel motion.

motion.name: coach-slide
motion.purpose: Coach progress bar segment; stops under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce zeroes durations and stops loops.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Home, Feedback and Moderation collapse to one column below this width.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Page side padding 32px, galley margin column 200px, history grid drops track. Profile fact sheet term column 140px. Messages: conversation list 240px, gap 20px, bubbles up to 90%, pane padding 16px sides.

breakpoints.name: graph-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Practice graph cells drop from 10px to 9px and gaps from 3px to 2px so the year fits without scrolling. The member filters wrap from four columns to two.

breakpoints.name: short-window
breakpoints.purpose: Messages tightens its bottom padding to 20px and its head spacing to 16px.

layout.profileAvatar: 96px, 5px ground ring, overlapping the banner by 48px
layout.memberFilters: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1.2fr, 16px gap; two columns below 1100px; fields 42px tall
layout.chatThreadMin: 140px; the thread scrolls, the composer area scrolls when the coach check is open

components.name: Report Dialog
components.description: The second floating layer after the palette: 520px sheet, float shadow, 35% black backdrop, no open/close animation; reason as radio rows with an ink accent, short sans textarea, quiet Cancel and primary Send.

components.css: .ds-dialog{width:min(520px,92vw);padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;background:var(--sheet,#20232b);color:var(--ink,#e8e6e1);border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3a3f4b);border-radius:var(--r-sheet,10px);box-shadow:0 12px 32px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55),0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35);font:400 var(--text-base,0.9375rem)/1.6 var(--font-ui,'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif)}.ds-dialog h2{margin:0;font-size:var(--text-lg,1.0625rem);font-weight:600}.ds-dialog-lede{margin:-8px 0 0;color:var(--ink-2,#b4b9c5)}.ds-radio-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:var(--r-control,6px);cursor:pointer}.ds-radio-row:hover{background:var(--sheet-hover,#262a33)}.ds-radio-row input{accent-color:var(--ink,#e8e6e1);width:16px;height:16px;margin:0}

components.name: Inline Confirmation
components.description: Block, account deletion and moderation decisions confirm inline, never in a modal: a neutral strong-rule sheet panel; the typed e-mail or required reason is the guard; no amber, no danger colour; the confirming action is secondary.

components.name: Moderation Queue

narrative.overview:
Every answer the learner writes is a galley, and the coach marks it the way an editor marks a proof: in non-repro blue pencil, with numbered carets in the line and short notes in the margin beside the line they mark. Removals are struck through in dusty rose and insertions sit beside them in sage; these are edits, not grades. The interface around the galley is a quiet desktop tool: a graphite ground, raised sheets with 1px rules, sans-serif chrome, and monospace wherever the learner's own words or a reusable expression appear.

Density is that of a working document rather than a dashboard. Content is set in one main column with a narrow side column; lists are ruled, not boxed; headings are sentence-case and plain. The system rejects the category default it was built against: a grey dashboard of stat cards with one violet accent. Progress is shown as facts, ruled lists and tally marks, never as metric tiles.

Dark is the default theme; a light theme swaps to a cool white sheet on pale grey with a darker pencil. Both themes share every structural rule.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, pencil blue, carrying only the coach's voice and the primary action.
Desaturated rose/sage diff marks on monospace text; never "wrong/right" colouring.
Flat raised sheets defined by 1px rules; shadow only on floating layers.
Margin notes aligned row by row to the line they annotate.
Sentence-case, untracked type throughout; no uppercase labels.
A few identifier colours (badge violet and copper, language brand colours, the graph green), each confined to one component.

rules.name: The Blue Pencil Rule
rules.body: Pencil blue belongs to the coach and to the one primary action on a screen. It never decorates headings, backgrounds or icons that the coach did not "write".

rules.name: The Edits, Not Grades Rule
rules.body: Rose and sage appear only as a pair of diff marks inside the learner's text. They are never status colours, never fills, never "correct/incorrect" signals; app errors use amber.

rules.name: The One Home Rule
rules.body: Every colour outside the neutrals has exactly one home: blue for the coach and the primary action, amber for app problems, rose and sage for the diff, violet for community badges, copper for evolution badges, brand colours for language badges, graph green for the graph. The graph green is never shown next to a diff.

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for the learner's own words, reusable expressions, keys and numbers; everything else is Public Sans. Never set interface chrome in mono or the galley in sans.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence-case with no tracking. The only letter-spacing in the system is the display title's -0.01em.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: Sheets, cards and buttons cast no shadow. If it is not floating over the page, it has no shadow.

dos: **Do** keep pencil blue to the coach's marks, notes, progress and the one primary action per view.
**Do** set the learner's text, expressions, keys and counts in JetBrains Mono, and everything else in Public Sans.
**Do** align every margin note to the galley line it marks, numbered to match its caret.
**Do** separate rows and sections with 1px rules and a top border rather than wrapping them in cards.
**Do** use the three-step tonal stack (rail, ground, sheet) for depth, and the float shadow only for overlays.
**Do** honour reduced motion: all durations drop to 0ms and looping animations stop.
**Do** confirm destructive actions inline in a neutral panel, guarded by a typed e-mail or a required reason.
**Do** let the icon carry a member badge's colour and keep its label in ink.
**Do** show an animated banner's first frame, still, under reduced motion or when "Play animated banners" is off.
**Do** make Follow the member profile's one primary action; once followed it becomes a secondary "Following" button.
**Do** mark the current People tab with a 2px ink underline on the rule, and keep Members marked on a member's profile and lists.
**Do** set follower, following and like counts in tabular figures as plain text beside their controls.
**Do** set chat messages, drafts and corrections in the chat mono, as plain text with their line breaks kept.
**Do** show a peer correction or a coach check as a word diff in the galley's rose and sage marks, the marks covering words only.
**Do** keep message actions quiet and under the message, reachable by keyboard and touch, and return focus to the message after an inline panel closes.
donts: **Don't** build a dashboard of stat cards or metric tiles; progress is facts, ruled lists and tallies.
**Don't** use rose or sage outside the diff, or label anything "wrong" or "correct".
**Don't** add a second accent colour or tint headings with the pencil. Badge violet and copper, language brand colours and the graph green are identifiers confined to their component, not accents.
**Don't** use violet, copper or the graph green outside member badges and the practice graph, or show the graph beside a diff.
**Don't** add shadows to sheets, cards or buttons.
**Don't** uppercase or letter-space labels, or put small category labels above headings.
**Don't** animate the command palette or the report dialog open or closed.
**Don't** colour destructive actions amber or red; amber stays for problems with the app.
**Don't** colour avatars or stack logos; logos take the text tone. A mascot is the only picture shown when there is no photo, and only language badges carry brand colour.
**Don't** rank or sort people by followers or likes, or give a count its own tile.
**Don't** colour the like heart; liked is the heart filled in the text tone.
**Don't** render chat text as HTML or markdown, or link-ify it; it is always plain text.
**Don't** mark a correction with anything but the diff marks: no rose or sage outside them, no "wrong" or "correct", no score.
**Don't** colour unread: the count is plain mono ink, in the rail and the conversation list, and unread rows are not bolded or tinted.
**Don't** tell a sender their request was declined; a decline is silent.
